Registration date / window: PRED-1337.F1 (deposit 1337, registered 2026-03-16) reads 'Baseline established 2025-12-24. Comparative assessment scheduled 2025-01-01.' (AXN-054A line 306): the assessment date precedes its baseline, likely meant 2026-01-01, and the deposit's registration is later than the dates it schedules.
